assembly_notes: Build one topology-defining host, derive a supported front bay from the selected front-module footprint, then mount either the integrated antenna treatment or a guided telescoping mast at a host-local upper corner. Slider, swivel, and clamshell candidates own only their host motion; numeric, QWERTY, touch, and senior deltas own only their front construction.

derived.name: host_width_m
derived.expression: max(source host width, front-module footprint width plus side support margins)
derived.rationale: QWERTY and senior layouts widen the local host bay without changing the selected host topology.

derived.name: front_bay_height_m
derived.expression: front-module screen and control stack height plus molded top and bottom margins
derived.rationale: Every front candidate remains fully supported and readable on every host.

derived.name: antenna_mount_xyz_m
derived.expression: selected host upper-right perimeter point offset outside the front-module footprint and moving carrier envelope
derived.rationale: The mast socket remains seated on the root shell and clear of slider, swivel, and lid motion.

required_author_checks: category_anchor: handheld body carries one display and one input surface
category_anchor: slider display exposes the supported front bay
category_anchor: swivel display rotates about the visible corner post
category_anchor: clamshell lid closes over the front module
category_anchor: every hardware key is repeated and presses inward
category_anchor: every hardware key remains exposed inside its front opening
category_anchor: touch front preserves broad glass and four physical controls
category_anchor: telescoping mast remains guided while extending

candidates.evidence: Boolean-unioned rounded shell sections form the parent monoblock; front-module pockets remain a derived host adaptation instead of additional host candidates.

candidates.evidence: Separate lower and upper rounded slabs retain a flush slide face and a +Y prismatic carrier; unchanged keypad construction is intentionally excluded from this candidate.

candidates.evidence: Thick lower shell, split body knuckles, bridged display lid and horizontal hinge necessarily form one structural family because the whole host topology changes.

candidates.evidence: Parent front module combines a small inset LCD, three shaped function controls and twelve numeric press parts.
